items.exampleEn: The old clock still functions after a hundred years.
items.exampleZh: 那座老時鐘過了一百年還能運作。

items.exampleEn: Use the search box to find a word.
This tie looks good with your shirt.
items.exampleZh: 這條領帶和你的襯衫很搭。

items.exampleEn: Kids love to explore new places.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們喜歡探索新地方。

items.exampleEn: The piano is my favorite instrument.
items.exampleZh: 鋼琴是我最喜歡的樂器。

items.sentenceEn: Please shut the window. It's cold.

items.audioEn: Can you remind me to buy milk tomorrow?
items.audioZh: 你明天可以提醒我買牛奶嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話的人請對方提醒他做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
My phone doesn't function well in the cold.
items.sentenceZh: 我的手機在寒冷的天氣裡不太好用。

items.stemEn: My father always wears his ____ to the office.
items.stemZh: 我爸爸上班總是打著他的領帶。

items.stemEn: We spent the afternoon ____ the old town.
items.stemZh: 我們花了一整個下午探索老城區。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my little sister's cat disappeared. We started a search right away. Our cat often goes out to explore, so we walked down every street near our home, and Dad reminded us to look under the cars. In the evening, we found the lost cat in my music room. It was sleeping in the box of my old instrument, a guitar! Dad laughed and said, "Next time, let's look at home first."
items.passageZh: 上週六，我妹妹的貓不見了。我們馬上開始找。我們的貓常常跑出去到處探索，所以我們走遍家附近的每一條街，爸爸還提醒我們看看車子底下。到了傍晚，我們在我的音樂房裡找到那隻走失的貓。牠正睡在我舊樂器——一把吉他——的盒子裡！爸爸笑著說：「下次我們先在家裡找吧。」

options: 走遍家附近的每一條街

referenceEn: Which instrument do you like best?
Which instrument do you like the most?
rubricZh: 「最喜歡」可寫，例如 like best、like the most 等；寫 What is your favorite instrument? 也正確

items.promptZh: 這張照片讓我想起我的童年。
referenceEn: This photo reminds me of my childhood.
This picture reminds me of my childhood.
rubricZh: 用 remind A of B 表示「讓 A 想起 B」（例如 reminds me of）
主詞是單數，動詞加 s（例如 reminds）
